messages:
tess: Quick sync  final announce Friday 09:00 PT. Need eng to confirm changelog URL, migration note, and canary schedule.
omar: I'll push the changelog link by 5pm. Marketing wants a single landing redirect + anchors to release-notes and migration.
rebecca: Will add anchors and a short "what's new" 3-bullet callout. Webinar CTA: provide a 30s blurb and registration URL.
tess: Inbound routing: tag registrations with X-Region so Sales can route (NA/EMEA/APAC). Who owns mapping?
omar: infra-bot can add header and example payload.
infra-bot: staging form updated. Example: POST /api/register Headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Region":"NA","X-Source":"announce"} Body: {"email":"..."}
rebecca: Canary plan: 20m canary at 09:00 -> ramp 40m -> full at +2h if green. Thresholds: 5xx <0.2%, p95 latency delta <10%.
tess: Marketing needs two subject lines for A/B and a 1-line tweet copy by EOD.
omar: Tweet: "Lower LLM inference cost and risk with smarter batching, KV cache, and safer rollouts. Read more: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/sep"
tess: Thanks all  I'll collate assets and post the final announce plan.
